observation_model.truth_preservation: store source centerline graph and exact generator parameters independently of derived observations

cases.name: depth_separated_projection_crossing
cases.truth: two independent filaments share an XY projection but have non-overlapping Z intervals

cases.name: shallow_ambiguous_projection_crossing
cases.truth: uncertainty intervals overlap and projection is ambiguous

cases.name: true_y_junction
cases.truth: three centerlines meet at a shared 3D node

cases.name: true_four_way_junction
cases.truth: four centerlines meet at a shared 3D node

cases.name: near_touch_without_connection
cases.truth: centerlines approach within image resolution but do not touch in 3D

cases.name: partial_z_slice_dropout
cases.truth: true graph retained but selected focal planes absent

cases.name: low_contrast_edge_dropout
cases.truth: one edge weakly observed or absent in selected slices

cases.name: antiparallel_flow_without_fusion
cases.truth: separate streams with opposite flow direction and no topological connection

cases.name: depth_unresolved_parallel_filaments
cases.truth: parallel filaments are optically indistinguishable at current Z-step

cases.name: focus_depth_bias
cases.truth: shape-from-focus estimate is systematically displaced from true z

cases.name: crossing_near_branch_node
cases.truth: projection crossing lies close to a genuine branch on one filament

cases.name: multi_cycle_topology_ambiguity
cases.truth: multiple overlapping graph cycles; local edge deletion can alter global connectivity

splits.unit: complete generated scene and all of its noisy/blurred variants
leakage_prohibited: same source graph in train and test
same seed/config sibling split across train and test

acceptance_targets_not_results.false_fusion: zero on known depth-separated and near-touch controls at the preregistered operating point
acceptance_targets_not_results.ambiguous_depth: abstain or preserve multiple hypotheses; do not force a single junction
acceptance_targets_not_results.performance: compare geometry error at matched topology error, compute and memory
acceptance_targets_not_results.calibration: selective risk/coverage and interval coverage on held-out generator families
acceptance_targets_not_results.biology_claim: none without admitted external biological image benchmark

crossing_hypothesis_contract.critical_boundary: This is a set of admissible graph-topology hypotheses, not a probability distribution and not a positive fusion detector.
crossing_hypothesis_contract.downstream_policy: Preserve both topologies or request independent review; never convert the shared-junction hypothesis directly into a graph mutation.

observation_receipt_contract.claim_boundary: Receipt validates traceability, declared calibration and uncertainty fields; it does not establish measurement correctness.
